blockers.description: Official documentation bodies and per-page hashes are external, so provider-required subjects remain blocked.
The exact generated documentation build and API closure are not reproduced.
The provider document projection has an unresolved blocking official-document loss: generated-build-not-replayed.

limitations: Exact release documentation and example tree metadata are retained without bodies or executable/serialized artifacts.

External raw identity is the SHA-256 of canonical sorted git ls-tree -r receipt lines '<mode> <object_type> <object_id>\t<path>\n' for every inventory entry; the local inventory JSON is metadata evidence only and contains no official document body bytes.
Slice projections are validated against the provider source partition.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.
This exact metadata inventory does not establish dependency compatibility, native CLI behavior, backend equivalence, model validity, or scientific acceptance.

entries.description: Only exact Git path and object metadata are retained; official documentation body bytes remain external.
Generated API/reference pages and the exact documentation build have not been replayed.
Tutorial datasets, NumPy/HDF5 payloads, checkpoints, models, pickles, and other executable or serialized artifacts are metadata-only and are never loaded.
